αἱρείτω: αἱρέω — take, seize; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it seize’
αἴαντα: Αἴας — Ajax, the great Telamonian hero; masc. acc. sg.
αἴθωνος: αἴθων — blazing, tawny, fiery; adj., masc. gen. sg., of a lion
αὐλῇ: αὐλή — courtyard, farmyard; fem. dat. sg.
αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. acc. pl., with a first-person pronoun: ’ourselves’ (ἡμέας αὐτούς) · also plain pronoun, ’them’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
βουλὰς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow; gen. sg.: ’of an ox’
βὰν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.: ’old man!’
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian, standing epithet of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from a place Gerenia, or linked to γέρας ’honour’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object of a verb of putting on: ’skin’
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
διογενὲς: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; masc. voc. sg.
διομήδεα: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δυσμενέεσσιν: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσιν (= Attic -έσι)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰσορόων: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶν)
εἰσὶν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they are’
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἵαται: ἧμαι — sit, be seated, be posted; perf. mid. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic κάθηνται)
εἵατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic (= Attic ἧντο): ’sat, stood (of ranks)’
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up (for himself)’
εὗδον: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (Attic ηὗδον, ἐκάθευδον): ’they slept’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form)
εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl. act. (augmented εὗρον = Attic ηὗρον)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θέτο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put (for himself)’
θην: θήν — surely, I warrant, to be sure; emphatic particle
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (καθ’ ἵππων) · also + acc., ’according to’ (καθ’ ἡμέτερον νόον ’according to our mind’)
κακήν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κλισίην: κλισίη — hut, shelter, tent; fem. acc. sg. (Attic κλισία)
κλισίης: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic κλισίας), with ἐκ: ’out of the hut’
κύδιστε: κύδιστος — most glorious, greatest; masc. voc. sg., superlative, address
λάχνη: λάχνη — wool, downy hair; fem. nom. sg.
λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host; masc. nom. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς, pl. λεῴ)
λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
λὰξ: λάξ — with the heel, with the foot; adv.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’) · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’fight!’ (μάχεσθαι ἐνὶ πρώτοισι)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg.
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’
μεταλλᾷς: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 2 sg., + acc.
μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., used with an imperative to forbid: ’and let not’
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’)
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’flocks’
μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὑφαίνειν: ’a plan’ · also object of ἐνίψει: ’cunning’ (νόον καὶ μῆτιν ’mind and cunning’) · also object of τεκτήναιτο: ’(frame) cunning’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
ναὶ: ναί — yes, verily; affirmative particle (ναὶ μὰ + acc. in oaths; ναὶ δή ’yes indeed’)
νεώτεροι: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’younger’
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, after διά: ’(through) the night’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of a verb of covering: ’night’ (νύκτα … ἐκάλυψε) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἕλκω: ’night’ (ἕλκον νύκτα ’drawing night’)
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl. νῆες
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἴω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg., act. form (= ὀΐω; Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; masc. dat. sg.: ’to him alone’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’ · also intensive after a relative pronoun, accented before the enclitic φασι: ’whom indeed’ · also intensive after ὅτε, accented before τε: ’just when’
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’)
ποδηνεκές: ποδηνεκής — reaching to the feet; adj., neut. acc. sg. (= Attic ποδήρης)
ποικίλον: ποικίλος — intricately wrought, many-coloured, dappled; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πέπλον
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many counsels, very wily, epithet of Odysseus (μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολὺς: πολύς — much, many, great; masc. nom. sg., grave accent mid-clause (πολὺς ὀρυμαγδός ’a great din’)
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’)
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
προέηκα: προΐημι — send forth, shoot; aor. 1 sg. act., epic προέηκα (= Attic προῆκα): ’I sent forth’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πυλάων: πύλη — gate; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after παύσαντο: ’from toil’
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic σφᾶς): ’them’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic σφίσιν): ’among them, to them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’)
τίφθ: τίπτε (τί ποτε) — why, what then?; interrog. adv., elided τίπτ’, and τίφθ’ before a rough breathing
ταχὺν: ταχύς — swift, quick; adj., masc. acc. sg.
ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic · also elided ταῦτ’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τούσδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’these’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδην: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. acc. sg. (patronymic)
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with οὔ τι: ’so much’ (οὔ τι τόσον ’not so much’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so she spoke’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’ · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’own, dear’ (φίλα γούνατα ’my own knees’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φυλάκων: φύλαξ — guard, watchman; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the guards’
φυλάσσετε: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic φυλάττετε): ’guard’
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χάρμα: χάρμα — joy, delight, source of joy; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition · also neut. acc. sg., predicate after γενέσθαι: ’a joy’
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
χρειὼ: χρειώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (= Attic χρεία)
χῶρος: χῶρος — place, spot; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγρομένοισιν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. mid. part., syncopated (ἀγρόμενος), masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’gathered’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν), agreeing with νύκτα: ’immortal’ · also noun ἀμβροσίη, fem. acc. sg.: ’ambrosia’ (food of the gods)
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
ἀνώγῃ: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); subj. 3 sg., after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’may bid’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀριστῆας: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, champion; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀτάλαντον: ἀτάλαντος — equal in weight, matching (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοῖς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἄγεν: ἄγω — lead, take, bring; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἦγεν) · also ἄγνυμι — break; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐάγησαν): ’were bent, broken back’ (of arrow-barbs)
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’valiant’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἐγγύς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv., with a gen. as a preposition: ’near’
ἐγείρομεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, awaken; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., short vowel, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα κε: ’that we may rouse’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl. in a temporal clause after ὁππότε: ’when we rouse’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl., short vowel, standing for the future in a main clause: ’we shall rouse’
ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for oneself)’
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλήλατο: ἐλαύνω — drive, push through; plpf. pass. 3 sg., reduplicated (= Attic ἐλήλατο): ’had been driven’
ἐλεαίρεις: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity, have compassion on; pres. 2 sg. act.
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπέοικε: ἐπέοικα (ἐπείκω) — be fitting, befit; perf. 3 sg., present sense, impersonal: ’it befits’
ἐπενήνοθε: ἐπενήνοθε — grows on, lies thick on; old perf. 3 sg. with present sense, root uncertain (ἐνήνοθε, ἐπενήνοθε)
ἐπικεύσω: ἐπικεύθω — hide further, keep back, conceal; fut. 1 sg. · also aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel, with future sense: ’I will (not) hide’
ἐποιχόμενοι: ἐποίχομαι — go about to, go among; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going about’
ἐποιχόμενος: ἐποίχομαι — go against, assail, come upon; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’assailing, going about’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑέσσατο: ἕννυμι — put on, clothe oneself in; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἡμφιέσατο): ’put on’
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔγχεα: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἔγχη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’spears’ (ἔγχεα ὀξυόεντα ’sharp spears’)
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔμιχθεν: μείγνυμι (Attic μίγνυμι) — mix; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -θεν (= Attic ἐμίχθησαν), intrans.: ’they mingled’
ἔνδυνε: ἐνδύω (ἐνδύνω) — put on (clothing); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented ἔνδυνε (= ἐνέδυνε): ’put on’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’)
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἤλυθ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλυθ’ = ἤλυθε), epic (= Attic ἦλθε)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἵκει: ἵκω — come to, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg. act., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀλίγος: ὀλίγος — little, small, puny; masc. nom. sg.
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀρυμαγδὸς: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, clamour; masc. nom. sg.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὁρμήν: ὁρμή — onset, rush, impulse; fem. acc. sg.: ’onrush, attack’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὄρεσφι: ὄρος — mountain (epic οὖρος); neut. pl. in -φι(ν), ablatival/locatival (= Attic gen. ὀρῶν or dat. ὄρεσι): ’down the mountains’
ὄφελεν: ὀφείλω (ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤφελε(ν)); with ὡς + inf., an unfulfilled wish: ’would that’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισι: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’)
ῥινὸν: ῥινός — skin, hide; fem. acc. sg.: ’the skin’
